narr: An upper level low was located over northern GA with shortwave energy rotating through the base of the trough. Moderate instability and a moist air mass was present with precipitable water values around 1.8 inches. Slow moving thunderstorms with high rain rates moved over the Augusta metro area.
ev: Skywarn net controller reported at least 8 inches of water over roadway near the intersection of Furys Ferry and Southern Pines Dr.
Trained spotter reported overflowing parking lot with several inches of water crossing North Leg Rd near Sibley Rd, causing a wash out.
lsr: Skywarn net controller report of at least 8 inches of water over roadway near the intersection of Fury Ferry & Southern Pine Road. Possible pond overflowing onto roadway.
Trained spotter reported overflowing parking lot caused road damage from wash out close to the library near North Leg Road (Jackson Road).
